title: Indian Railways Approves Construction of 4 Lane ROB at Geratpur-Ahmedabad Section in Gujarat at ₹153 Crore
body_text:
In a major step towards safer and smoother movement of road traffic in Gujarat, Indian Railways has approved the construction of a 4 lane Road Over Bridge at Level Crossing No. 305 on the Geratpur-Ahmedabad section of Western Railway. The work has been sanctioned at a cost of ₹153 crore.
The project has been sanctioned under Western Railway's ongoing umbrella work for construction of road over and under bridges, foot over bridges, drainage improvement and rebuilding of road over and under bridges.
The crossing lies in a densely populated urban area, which calls for longer approaches and a larger structure. The railway bridge portion will have a total length of 106 metres. It will comprise two composite girders of 53 metres each. A viaduct of 150 metres will follow. The railway approach will extend to 595 metres.
Safer and Faster Movement for Commuters
The new Road Over Bridge will remove the need for road users to wait at the level crossing. It will allow uninterrupted movement of vehicles across the railway line at all hours. Road users in the area will gain safer passage, shorter travel time and relief from congestion at the crossing.
The approval reflects Indian Railways' continued commitment towards elimination of level crossings, improved public safety and creation of modern and efficient transport infrastructure across the country.
*****
Dharmendra Tewari/ Dr. Nayan Solanki/ Manik Sharma

enrichment.summary: Indian Railways has sanctioned construction of a 4-lane Road Over Bridge (ROB) at Level Crossing No. 305 on the Geratpur-Ahmedabad section of Western Railway in Gujarat, at a cost of ₹153 crore. The bridge will have a 106-metre railway bridge portion with two 53-metre composite girders, a 150-metre viaduct, and a 595-metre road approach, aimed at eliminating the level crossing and enabling uninterrupted vehicular movement.
enrichment.context:
Level crossings on Indian Railways are frequent bottlenecks for road traffic and pose significant safety risks, including accidents caused by vehicles attempting to cross before trains pass. Elimination of unmanned and even manned level crossings through construction of Road Over Bridges (ROBs) and Road Under Bridges (RUBs) has been a long-standing priority for Indian Railways, tied to its broader safety modernization agenda under missions like 'Mission Zero Accident' and various safety funds such as the Rashtriya Rail Sanraksha Kosh (RRSK). This project falls under Western Railway's umbrella scheme for ROB/RUB construction, foot over bridges, and drainage improvement, indicating a systematic, zone-wide approach rather than a one-off sanction.

Such infrastructure investments also support urban mobility and last-mile connectivity in growing metropolitan areas like Ahmedabad, where population density necessitates longer bridge approaches and larger structures to accommodate traffic flow without disrupting rail operations. These projects are typically funded through a combination of railway funds and state government contributions, reflecting cooperative federalism in infrastructure development.

prelims_questions.question: The elimination of level crossings on Indian Railways through construction of Road Over Bridges (ROBs) primarily aims to achieve which of the following?
options: Increase freight carrying capacity of railway wagons
Reduce accidents and eliminate traffic congestion at road-rail intersections
Reduce railway ticket prices for passengers
prelims_questions.explanation: The release explicitly states that the ROB will remove the need for road users to wait at the level crossing, allow uninterrupted vehicle movement, and improve public safety by eliminating the level crossing.

prelims_questions.question: The Geratpur-Ahmedabad section, where the newly sanctioned Road Over Bridge is located, falls under which railway zone?
prelims_questions.explanation: The release states the project is on the Geratpur-Ahmedabad section of Western Railway and is sanctioned under Western Railway's umbrella work for such infrastructure.
